Here are several title suggestions for your painting:

**"The Sentinel's Oath"**

Other options:
- "Blade of the Realm"
- "The Iron Guardian"
- "Keeper of the Ancient Sword"
- "The Warrior's Stand"
- "Champion of the Forgotten Kingdom"
- "The Swordbearer"
- "Defender of the Last Gate"

These titles evoke the epic fantasy nature of the portrait while highlighting the warrior's noble bearing and his detailed sword, suggesting both power and purpose.
